senses.sense_definition: A sweet, juicy tropical fruit with a thick purple rind and white segments inside.

examples.text: The <w>mangosteen</w> is often called the queen of fruits because of its delicious flavor.

target_lang_translations.zh: <w>山竹</w>因其美味常被称为水果皇后。

examples.text: We bought a fresh <w>mangosteen</w> at the local market during our trip to Thailand.

target_lang_translations.zh: 我们在泰国旅行时，在当地市场买了一个新鲜的<w>山竹</w>。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 一种热带水果，果皮厚且呈紫色，果肉呈白色，味道甜美多汁。

senses.sense_definition: The tropical evergreen tree that produces the mangosteen fruit.

examples.text: The <w>mangosteen</w> requires a warm and humid climate to grow properly.

target_lang_translations.zh: <w>山竹树</w>需要温暖潮湿的气候才能正常生长。

examples.text: Farmers carefully prune each <w>mangosteen</w> to ensure a better harvest next season.

target_lang_translations.zh: 农民们仔细修剪每一棵<w>山竹树</w>，以确保下一季能有更好的收成。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 产出山竹果实的热带常绿乔木。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指山竹这种植物或树木。
